corrections.text: The article reports InfoQ's description of a Layerbase YCSB comparison of FerretDB and DocumentDB without saying that Layerbase sells both products as hosted databases. Layerbase's own post on the comparison (layerbase.com, October 23, 2026, not cited in the article) says: "our cloud MongoDB-compatible options are FerretDB and DocumentDB." The post tested the documentdb-local:pg17-1.0.0 image, and neither InfoQ nor the article states the DocumentDB version.

The article says the commit linked in issue #806 is "dated 2026-10-24". That is the commit's authored date; GitHub's commit data gives its committed date as 2026-11-03 (19:42 UTC), about two minutes before the 2026-11-03 comment (19:43 UTC) that links it. The commit is not in the v1.2-0 tag.
